data: Only TRAIN/DEV; no CAL/TEST discovery; paper and repository metadata are not row-level access

source: At least two independent source families with executable policy Gold; candidate Twins and LANL are not assumed equivalent
Freeze rule version, checkpoint, LoRA, head, tokenizer, calibration and precision hashes
Identify state transitions with deterministic rule oracle and preserve all unrelated fields
Check semantic comparability, source independence, option meanings and policy priority

twins: Baseline no conflict/quorum below threshold -> add one authentic valid vote, verify no conflict: reject probability should not rise
Baseline no conflict/quorum present -> add observed conflicting voter: acceptance should not rise and Gold changes to reject
Sham edit with identical token length but unchanged semantic evidence
lanl: Increase only preceding failures in stated time window while holding current event and rule fixed; policy triage cannot become more permissive if rule is monotone
Keep same-second ambiguity and event chronology explicit; exclude nonmonotone policy cases
negative_controls: Candidate order/name with semantic mapping fixed
metrics: strict policy false allow and false reject
pairwise monotonicity violation rate and source-stratified confidence intervals
query-only/key-only/joint state patch necessity and sufficiency

future_gpu_if_admitted.model: 0.8B or 2B frozen exact checkpoint after resource confirmation
future_gpu_if_admitted.stop_when: No strict natural positive after pre-registered DEV search; do not tune on TEST

attack_claim_requires: Independently verified attacker write control and deployment authorization Gold; absent these, label as model policy consistency only.
